name: GQA: Visual Reasoning and Compositional Question Answering
description: GQA is a visual reasoning benchmark containing compositional question-answering pairs grounded in dense scene graphs over 113,018 real-world images from Visual Genome. Developed by Stanford University and presented at CVPR 2019, the balanced release features 1,721,561 questions with reduced linguistic and prior biases to measure relational and multi-step visual reasoning.
